diagnostics.cause: Offline fixture bucket did not match configured parse_s3_uri bucket; corrected fixture.
Bronze atomic metadata encountered nested rule-initialization transaction; explicit repository savepoint added.
Isolated guard compared CIDR-form server address to plain loopback; corrected address parsing.
Intermediate test process retained the earlier fixture while a later fixture applied hardened admission migration. Fresh run uses durable admission consistently.
Incremental fixed-key lineage guard rejected immutable Silver candidate key. Corrected using current verified receipt + pinned file/rule/DQ/hash proof; targeted case passed.
Oversized autogenerated pytest parameter ID exceeded Windows environment-variable length. Explicit compact IDs fixed the run.

limits: No complete repository regression. Earlier passing runs are not silently relabeled as runs of the final worktree. Targeted reruns validate subsequent changes.
No actual S3/SQS/AWS/warehouse calls; artifacts use in-memory versioned storage and warehouse fakes.
Actual least-privilege role tests blocked by explicit prohibition on role/permission changes; only PUBLIC function ACLs, runtime fail-closed gates and transaction semantics tested locally.
Separate verifier deployment, cloud IAM/versioning/queue/redrive policies, dispatch supervision, realistic resource bounds and production acceptance remain manual gates.

New-path UPSERT/SNAPSHOT have targeted acceptance coverage, but final complete-suite acceptance and Gold plan removal/reconciliation remain outstanding; Exact V2 worker execution remains unsupported/rejected.
No application/public-schema migration, role modification, dependency installation, staging, commit, push or cloud deployment.
review_findings_fixed: Bronze rule initialization now composes through explicit savepoints without prematurely committing its outer transaction.
Immutable Silver lineage is accepted only through current verified receipt and pinned file/rule/DQ/hash checks; canonical legacy lineage assertions remain.
Opted-in physical-file creation, upload completion and source-version pinning share a transaction; rollback/retry tested.
Gold recovery advances the gold_runs base path along with catalog/receipt generation; the final pointer equality test passed.
Runtime gates reject owner/escalation-capable roles, direct table or column authority writes and shared verifier/publication authority; actual login privilege acceptance remains a release blocker.

Verifier checks lease, ownership and canonical input identities before any storage I/O; SQL also binds intent file/association and incremental application scope to the authorized job. Final validation covers forged-input zero-read behavior.
warnings: Git CRLF conversion notices; diff whitespace checks pass
release_blocked_checks: Separate least-privilege login acceptance (role/permission changes explicitly prohibited)
Actual cloud IAM/versioning/queue/DLQ/recovery acceptance (AWS access prohibited)
Container/verifier bootstrap, supervision, capacity and shutdown acceptance; explicit deployment approval

manual_acceptance_followup.scope: Targeted recovery after interrupted final acceptance
manual_acceptance_followup.qualification: Previously failed cases passed in later sequential reruns. The complete 34-case final selection and 1506-case broad regression were not demonstrated passing as complete runs.
